propositions: Add immutable OperationSnapshot type with validated non-secret effective values, explicit source-kind provenance, selected repository root, and envelope version for central configuration authority

Implement composition precedence ordering: explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, with independent repository root selection via repo_root parameter or REBAR_ROOT or Git top-level

Thread shadow-mode snapshot through CLI, library operations, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points without changing execution or stored formats; shadow composition failures emit redacted warnings and defer to legacy authoritative path

Malformed selected operation config raises typed config error before lock/network/write effects; all other snapshot assembly/fingerprint/diagnostic failures are caught and do not alter ticket/bridge formats

REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW environment variable controls shadow mode default-enabled state; setting to canonical false disables shadow construction and restores legacy behavior; switch is temporary and removed in S7
Snapshot is byte-stable per operation capture; environment/file/cwd mutations after capture do not affect current snapshot and are observed by subsequent operations
